goal_text: Using the authoritative JSON source https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/rest/pug/compound/name/octane/property/HeavyAtomCount/JSON, extract JSON path PropertyTable.Properties.0.HeavyAtomCount and save the knowledge evidence to canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/PARENT_CHEMISTRY_OCTANE_HEAVY_ATOM_COUNT.json. Using the authoritative JSON source https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/rest/pug/compound/name/oxygen/property/HeavyAtomCount/JSON, extract JSON path PropertyTable.Properties.0.HeavyAtomCount and save the knowledge evidence to canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/PARENT_CHEMISTRY_OXYGEN_HEAVY_ATOM_COUNT.json. Using the authoritative JSON source https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/rest/pug/compound/name/carbon%20dioxide/property/HeavyAtomCount/JSON, extract JSON path PropertyTable.Properties.0.HeavyAtomCount and save the knowledge evidence to canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/PARENT_CHEMISTRY_CARBON_DIOXIDE_HEAVY_ATOM_COUNT.json. Using the authoritative JSON source https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/rest/pug/compound/name/water/property/HeavyAtomCount/JSON, extract JSON path PropertyTable.Properties.0.HeavyAtomCount and save the knowledge evidence to canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/PARENT_CHEMISTRY_WATER_HEAVY_ATOM_COUNT.json. Calculate the predicted octane heavy atom count using predicted_octane_heavy_atom_count = (16 * carbon_dioxide_heavy_atom_count + 18 * water_heavy_atom_count - 25 * oxygen_heavy_atom_count) / 2. Determine whether the predicted and authoritative octane heavy atom counts differ by at most 0.

required_result.producer_result: The final bounded numeric relation artifact emitted by the compiled controller plan.

independent_oracle.method: Re-fetch all four exact PubChem URLs outside the Brain producer, independently parse PropertyTable.Properties.0.HeavyAtomCount, recompute the octane heavy-atom count implied by 2 C8H18 + 25 O2 -> 16 CO2 + 18 H2O, recompute the absolute difference and <=0 predicate, and compare every consequential relation field.
